main_measure.name: mean unusual 10-bar move in the short direction over the cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: t >= +2 confirms (with deeper-minus-shallower > 0); t <= -2 rejects; fewer than 30 distinct case days is not observable

supporting_check.name: deeper half minus shallower half mean unusual move

decided_by: The main t lies between -2 and +2. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.099 (below 1), 218 cases (30 needed).
reading: Profile taken as the recorded regime 'unknown' (not vetoed to chop), down day as the scaled_fall raw value < 0; a case is the first short bet in each 10-bar grid cell of its window, the t clusters cases by UTC day with a D/(D-1) correction, and the median split puts cases strictly above the median of |forecast| in the deeper half, at or below in the shallower.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.099 (below 1), 218 cases (30 needed)
